target: Full lifetime GPUh of frozen eligible jobs submitted in each of 24 next-day local-clock hours
population: PR42/PR59 exact eligible GPU Job IDs

lightgbm.target_transform: log1p; exact expm1 inverse, original-unit evaluation

neural.implementation: PR59 SmallTFT and hurdle-lognormal SmallDeepAR adapted to 24-step decoder
neural.early_stop: minimum original-unit raw Q90 pinball on DEVELOPMENT
neural.TFT_loss: original-unit weighted Q50/Q90 pinball .2/.8; log1p quantile parameterization
neural.DeepAR_loss: hurdle occurrence plus positive lognormal NLL; inference never teacher-forced

seasonal: TRAIN same weekday and hour >=8 days; else same hour; empirical Q50/Q90

development_selection.diagnostic_calibration: chronological DEVELOPMENT residual days mature before issue; minimum20 days; per-hour finite rank
development_selection.role: internal selection only; not unbiased validation of a selected architecture
development_selection.family_metric: average seed metrics, no best-seed selection

final_calibration.source: eligible CALIBRATION days only; all labels strictly before first Dec issue
final_calibration.score: actual_GPUh - raw_Q90_GPUh; separately for each target hour
final_calibration.rank: ceil(0.9*(n_days+1)); fail if rank exceeds n_days
final_calibration.correction: signed additive residual; Q90=max(Q50,0,rawQ90+delta_hour); Q50 unchanged
final_calibration.caveat: one residual per day/hour; no simultaneous-profile guarantee; serial nonexchangeability remains empirical

burst: strictly above TRAIN positive hourly target Q95

uncertainty.unit: day, seeds averaged within day, paired circular moving 7-day blocks within calendar-contiguous segments

success_gate.calibration: selected family seed-mean Q90 coverage 0.88..0.92 in BOTH evaluations, all seeds 0.85..0.95
success_gate.sharpness: selected seed-mean Q90 pinball and requirement ratio no worse than calibrated seasonal baseline in BOTH evaluations
success_gate.regimes: report positive and burst without excluding any hours; positive coverage >=0.80 and burst >=0.50 in BOTH evaluations
success_gate.replacement: above gates plus selected neural Q90 pinball delta upper 95% CI <0 vs LightGBM in BOTH evaluations
success_gate.integration: all integrity, calibration, sharpness, seed and regime gates pass; readiness means future interface design only

failure: preserve failed run receipts; no reduced evaluation population; no silent scientific rewrite after exposure
